Definition: from G2596 and G5351; to spoil entirely, i.e. (literally) to destroy; or (figuratively) to deprave; --corrupt, utterly perish.
BiblicalUsage: As Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these resist the truth, men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe truth has always had its counterfeits, and the test is whether the mind is sound or corrupt.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
